L5 records identify cefuroxime axetil as a PEPT1 substrate used to enhance oral bioavailability, and human absorption studies show pivampicillin, an acyloxyalkyl ester prodrug, was absorbed almost quantitatively despite intestinal ester hydrolysis.

No L5 record affirmatively supports F < 20% for the query; intestinal esterase hydrolysis and efflux records concern other prodrugs such as GS-5245 and tenofovir disoproxil, and are not threshold-relevant for the query.
